_doc: Raid-hound (act1/raid_hound.md): coat (mud-coloured), leather (the harness, the red-lacquered muzzle cage, the Order's mark, brass rings), eye. The coat's emission mask is the one small closed spawn_wound mark, the old gaff scar on its near shoulder (the weak point, ADR 0151; M3-CRE-650). write_materials.py on game/shaders/creature/creature.gdshader.
